ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio (~0.05); dominance of low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels with localized high-intensity white clusters and sparse circular points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark field across the majority of the surface area. High-intensity contiguous clusters are mapped strictly to the distal tips. Sparse, high-intensity circular points (scars) are scattered across the medial and distal quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 72 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 20% of the maximum lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations across the entire margin. A significant macro-scale rectangular indentation is located on the left trailing edge, approximately 70% distance from the notch toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve characterized by a concave transition from the median notch leading into a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous white, circular ring-like clusters (diameter ~10-25 pixels) distributed across the central and distal zones of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, non-parallel light-grey linear streaks (potential rake marks) observed on the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe and scattered across the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Traumatic loss of tissue resulting in a deep, irregular notch on the left trailing edge. Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Three-dimensional barnacle clusters protruding from the outer edges of the left and right tips, creating irregular high-contrast texture outside the smooth fluke boundary.
